caption: The drawing depicts a human figure, seen from the back and side, standing on a rectangular wooden platform. The figure is mostly nude, with pale, off-white skin accented by numerous red streaks resembling blood running vertically down the body, arms, legs, head, and feet. The head has a full head of dark black hair and a beard, the face is slightly turned downward and to one side. Around the waist, the figure has a green fabric draped and secured by a yellowish rope tied in a knot on the left side, leaving the legs exposed. A wooden upright support, brown in color, is attached at the back of the figure and the platform, with a rope from the figure's waist tied around it. The platform and support have a simple, unadorned wooden appearance, with visible grain and shading. The background is plain, off-white with faint grayish marks near the top edges. In the lower right corner, there is a small inscription that reads, "MARSEL O. GLOFAN TAOS."
title: Wooden Christo, Painted (Side view)
